observations.detail: new and manual Deserialize reject empty, zero IDs and duplicates while preserving original order; ids exposes an immutable slice. The shown compound binding constructs exactly two IDs and maps all member errors to Owner carrying property and front ID. Whether loss of detailed cause matters to its reporting consumer remains q1495; no new error-erasure count.

Source constructor requires all nonempty admitted finite nonvertical triangles, canonical sort, a derived query and extension. It retains repeated triangles, because sorting alone does not deduplicate. Query enumerates source positions and returns all intersecting indices. from_vista_lod checks raster shape, finite origin and positive spacing before narrowing and triangulation; values then face GroundTriangle admission. Coverage/overlap are not a constructor guarantee.

pub(super) triangle backing, private query and cached factor permit a privileged parent to invalidate coherence if it mutates backing after construction; query results index backing directly. The historical record states no actual bad caller. Earlier L11 says no external mutation through the public copied triangles() view; that narrower observation does not negate internal privileged access. No actual invalid mutation or crash shown, no new count.

An arbitrary scene polygon is routed through PlanPolygon; rigid projection preserves represented coordinates and may have small rounded bends. height_range fans the outline and discards failed triangle constructions, returns extremal intersections; floor select treats None as SourceSample. The complete projection, fan, intersection, policy and accepted coverage behavior remain open; no asserted actual malformed polygon.

conditional_findings.classification: Current source-level conditional area-check blind spot; not an observed product incident or accepted new unique ledger count.
conditional_findings.first_contract: If single coverage of every support triangle is required, aggregate overlap area must not mask an equally large uncovered area.
conditional_findings.trace: At source.rs 138–158 duplicate valid triangles are retained. geometry.rs 20–47 admits flat, finite nonvertical examples; query.rs 82–92 and 129–151 retains both candidate indices; geometry.rs 188–210 plus planar.rs 3–24 clips and measures each. For a flat support triangle with planar vertices (0,0),(2,0),(0,2), area is 2. Two identical flat source triangles (0,0),(1,0),(0,2) each intersect in area 1. foundations.rs 319–348 sums both and 351–374 compares 2 against support area 2, so its discrepancy is 0 even though one half is duplicated and another half uncovered. All heights equal zero, so the shown displacement check is neutral.
conditional_findings.limits: This is mathematical source reasoning only: no constructor, clipping operation, fixture, compiler, test, simulation or product ran. The example establishes the local visit_source_intersections/validate_coverage area predicate, not a successful full compiler result.
